summary: L4 intermediate checkpoint v32: eight plugin responsibilities, with numeric/date profiling and reduced tie-related guidance. Its 70.33% test result corroborates the later final v35 at 70.56%.

responsibilities.schema-contract: Exact schema names and bounded SQL identifier checks.
responsibilities.literal-contract: Ground filter values in observed database literals.
responsibilities.write-workflow: Track mutation execution and actual completion receipts.
responsibilities.result-bridge: Align observed result shape with final submission.
responsibilities.sql-recovery: Remember SQL errors and guide non-repeating recovery.
responsibilities.budget-conductor: Use remaining model-call budget and finish deliberately.
responsibilities.numeric-calendar: Handle numeric/date formats and relevant profiling.
responsibilities.intent-contract: Translate task intent into operation and direction constraints.

summary_zh: L4 中间检查点 v32：八个插件职责，强化数值与日期样例并减少并列值指导。70.33%的测试成绩支持后续最终版v35的70.56%并非孤立高点。
